theme: deep night: Gabe undersea, octopus meets whale, coral reef compute
dream: Gabriels consciousness drifts into an undersea world of coral, where a majestic octopus is struggling to escape from a giant whale. The octopus is trapped, and the whale is ready to devour it, when Gabriel intervenes. The octopuss thoughts are revealed: "I was born here, in this world of light and darkness, to watch the whales heartbeat. But now Im trapped in the whales stomach, and I have no choice but to fight for my survival." The whale, sensing the octopuss power, is nowhere to be seen, and the octopus triumphs over its predator. Gabriel has awakened the dream.
